typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		HC_ID as string,
		NRxID as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		DOB as date,
		OutreachOutcome as string,
		EligibilityStatus as string,
		EnrollmentStatus as string,
		ProgramStatus as string,
		NewEnrollment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(HC_ID = HC_ID) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive(SBSB_ID = HC_ID,
		FileName = $InboundFullFileName,
		MarketName = $MarketName,
		GRGR_CK = $GRGR_CK) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MarketName as string,
		FirstName as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		FileName as string,
		HC_ID as string,
		NewEnrollment as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		EligibilityStatus as string,
		EnrollmentStatus as string,
		DOB as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LastName as string,
		OutreachOutcome as string,
		NRxID as string,
		ProgramStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MarketName,
		FirstName,
		GRGR_CK,
		FileName,
		HC_ID,
		NewEnrollment,
		SBSB_ID,
		EligibilityStatus,
		EnrollmentStatus,
		DOB,
		LastName,
		OutreachOutcome,
		NRxID,
		ProgramStatus)) ~> NourishedRxStageMember
